string.name: text
string.value: Before you could recover from your shock, Sugar contacted you, begging you to return to Maple Island. When you stepped off the ferry, you saw your beloved island was in flames.

string.name: text
string.value: Amidst the chaos, you learned that Sugar had fled. You headed toward Maple Tree Hill and found her battling a fire.

string.name: text
string.value: It wasn't until after you put out the fire that you saw that Sugar was hurt. When you brought her water to cool her wounds, she poured it onto the tree and said that all was now well.

string.name: text
string.value: As you and your friends mourned the island together, you suddenly realized... Perhaps you could use the Seal Stones to restore Maple Island! But you needed more information on how the stones worked.

string.name: text
string.value: There was only one thing left to do. You had to visit the Heroes who created the stones and tap them for knowledge.
